using System;
using Etl.Core.Abstractions;
using LoadReferenceData.Csv;
using LoadReferenceData.Mapping;
using LoadReferenceData.Model;
using Xunit;

namespace LoadReferenceData.Tests;

public class DepartmentTransformTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Map_ComputesExpectedOutput_ForARepresentativeRow()
    {
        var row = new DepartmentCsvRow
        {
            DepartmentID = 7,
            DepartmentCode = "Sample",
            DepartmentName = "Sample",
            CostCenter = "Sample",
            HeadCount = 7,
        };
        var ctx = new RowContext(RowNumber: 1, LoadedAtUtc: new DateTime(2020, 6, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), SourceName: "DepartmentTransform");

        var result = new DepartmentTransform().Map(row, ctx);

        Assert.Equal(7, result.DepartmentID);
        Assert.Equal("Sample", result.DepartmentCode);
        Assert.Equal("Sample", result.DepartmentName);
        Assert.Equal("Sample", result.CostCenter);
        Assert.Equal(7, result.HeadCount);
        // DepartmentKey <- (DT_WSTR,25)(UPPER(DepartmentCode) + "-" + (DT_WSTR,10)DepartmentID)
        Assert.Equal("SAMPLE-7", result.DepartmentKey);
        // LoadedAtUtc <- GETUTCDATE()
        Assert.Equal(new DateTime(2020, 6, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), result.LoadedAtUtc);
    }
}
